description: This file defines the CountryService class in the OrangeHRM project, providing methods to manage countries and provinces, including retrieval and normalization functionalities. It interacts with the data access object (CountryDao) and models like CountryModel and ProvinceModel.

classes.name: CountryService
classes.description: Service class providing country and province management functionalities, including fetching lists, specific entries by code or name, and normalization of these entities.

methods.name: getCountryDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the CountryDao instance.

methods.name: setCountryDao
methods.description: Sets the CountryDao instance, mainly for dependency injection or testing.

methods.name: getCountryList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all countries.

methods.name: getProvinceList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all provinces.

methods.name: getCountryByCountryName
methods.description: Returns a Country entity matching the provided country name.

methods.name: getCountryByCountryCode
methods.description: Returns a Country entity matching the provided country code.

methods.name: getProvinceByProvinceCode
methods.description: Returns a Province entity matching the provided province code.

methods.name: getCountryArray
methods.description: Returns a normalized array of country models.

methods.name: getProvinceArray
methods.description: Returns a normalized array of province models.
